name: Cummy Friends
source:
One of the most wonderful things about Imaginary Friends is that they can literally be anything their creator wants! While Foster’s Home has always been a welcoming place for those Imaginary Friends that would otherwise be forgotten, one fact that has been lost to time is that the Mansion that makes up Foster’s Home itself, is in fact an imaginary friend!

Though it was allowed to slumber for decades, a certain event has awoken it! And now that it's alive and awake once more, it has remembered its true purpose. This Mansion wasn’t supposed to be an imagined mansion, it was supposed to be a Playboy Bunny Mansion! Help the house realise its horny dream of becoming a lewd mansion! And what does every Playboy Bunny Mansion need? A bunny! Which makes Frankie its main target as she’s led down a path of corruption.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/cummy-friends-v0-1-cummystudio.147104/]F95Zone[/url]]
translation:
幻想朋友最奇妙的一点，就是他们可以成为创造者想象中的任何模样！麻吉之家一直收留着那些可能被遗忘的幻想朋友，但有一个事实早已被岁月掩埋：麻吉之家所在的宅邸本身，其实也是一位幻想朋友！

它沉睡了几十年，却被某个事件唤醒！如今，它再度恢复生机，也想起了自己真正的使命。这座宅邸原本不该只是一幢想象出来的普通房子，而应该是一座花花公子兔女郎豪宅！帮助这幢房子实现变成淫靡豪宅的情色梦想吧！而每座兔女郎豪宅都需要什么？当然是兔女郎！于是，法兰珂成了它的主要目标，被一步步引向堕落。
